digest.name: rank-order
digest.why: repliers, then replies, then ts (newer first), then id ascending

digest.name: reply-rules
digest.why: self-replies and replies from another channel do not count; a non-window post is never returned

digest.name: caps
digest.why: per_channel skips a lower post of a full channel; limit stops the walk

digest.name: per-channel-one
digest.why: per_channel 1 with limit 20 returns the top post of the only channel

digest.name: remove-and-ban
digest.why: a removed reply does not count, a replier whose counted replies are all removed is not a replier, and a banned author's reply still counts
